simulation.title: Roleplay Session
simulation.subtitle: Practice difficult conversations in a safe space
simulation.startCostNote: The conversation and coach pauses are free – only the evaluation costs 1 credit ({eur}).
simulation.confirmBody: The evaluation costs 1 credit. You'll receive detailed feedback with scores, quoted evidence, key moments and one concrete next step. The conversation cannot be continued afterwards.
simulation.notEnoughTurns: Add at least three of your own messages before evaluating.
simulation.turnLimit: Maximum conversation length reached — please evaluate now.
simulation.paywall: No credits left — please top up to evaluate.
simulation.preflightPaywall: The evaluation needs 1 credit. Your balance is empty. Top up now so your practice session is not lost.
simulation.reauth: Please sign in again to use your credits.
simulation.unavailable: Service temporarily unavailable — please try again.
simulation.disabled: The conversation simulation is not enabled yet.
simulation.genericError: That didn't work — please try again.
simulation.c10Hint: Scored exactly like a transcript analysis — only what the conversation actually shows counts as observable.
simulation.criteriaIntro: These skills count in the evaluation. The weights show how much.
simulation.endedVerabschiedung: You said goodbye to each other.
simulation.endedAbbruch: The character walked out of the conversation.
simulation.endedHint: You can now get your evaluation.
simulation.liveIdleWarn: I can't hear anything. The connection will close in {s} seconds.
simulation.liveReconnecting: Connection dropped for a moment … one moment.
simulation.timeoutHint: The scene pauses — your counterpart won't notice a thing. The conversation clock keeps running. Grab an impulse, then play on.
simulation.timeoutLimit: All coach breaks of this simulation are used up.
simulation.micLive: Microphone on — just speak; your words land in the input field.
simulation.liveActive: Live conversation: just speak. You may interrupt.
simulation.timeUpBanner: Time is up — your counterpart had to leave for their next appointment. Evaluate the conversation now.
simulation.timeboxHonest: {min} minutes of real conversation time — the clock runs from the start, even if you leave the page.
simulation.finishNeedsTurns: Evaluation unlocks after three of your own messages — before that no fair verdict is possible.
simulation.deadEndBody: Time ran out before an evaluable conversation could develop. (No credit charged.)
simulation.leaveBody: Your run stays open — the conversation clock keeps running anyway.
simulation.checkinQuestion: How did it go from your point of view — what worked, where did you struggle?
simulation.historyHint: Score per attempt · dashed line = pass mark
simulation.deliveryHint: Impact hints — they do not affect your score.
simulation.modeCheckHint: Assessment mode: no coach pauses, stricter pass mark — like a real exam.
simulation.hardnessHint: Gentle opens up faster, Tough insists longer on positions — same situation, different counterpart.
simulation.builderSubtitle: Create custom roleplays for your team
simulation.builderAdminOnly: The scenario builder is available to workspace admins only. Ask your admin if your team needs a custom scenario.
simulation.builderBriefPlaceholder: Who is practicing what, with whom — and what makes the conversation hard? A few sentences on situation, audience and learning goal …
simulation.builderMaterialPlaceholder: Product info, typical objections, prices, internal facts — the generator uses ONLY these facts instead of inventing any.
simulation.builderGenerating: Drafting — this can take up to a minute …
simulation.builderGenerateFailed: Generation failed. Please try again or make the brief more specific.
simulation.builderNoCredits: Not enough credits for a generation.
simulation.builderLimit: Maximum number of custom scenarios reached — delete an existing one first.
simulation.builderEmpty: No custom scenarios yet — describe your first conversation above.
simulation.builderDnaWarning: Visible to you as the author only — learners never see this, otherwise the exercise would be pointless.
simulation.builderRevisePlaceholder: e.g. Make the persona negotiate harder, and goal 3 should reference the annual plan …
simulation.builderCardBody: Build a roleplay from your real conversation — with your objections and facts.
simulation.aiNotice: You are talking to an AI. Your input is sent to an AI model for evaluation.
simulation.micNoticeBody: Your voice is converted to text in our data centre in Western Europe (Microsoft Azure) and is not stored there. If this service is currently unavailable, your browser uses its own speech recognition and sends the recording to its maker (Chrome: Google). If you prefer not to, type your answer.
simulation.aiStartNotice: You are training with an AI agent. The character, voice and answers are computer-generated.
simulation.coachCardsTitle: Cards that support your next step
simulation.builderVoiceNote: This voice speaks in the conversation. You can switch at any time, even after publishing.
simulation.consentBody: Your company asks for your consent before the first voice recording: your voice is converted to text in Western Europe, the recording is not stored. You can always type instead.

analyze.dragDropHint: Drag a Teams PDF here or use the button.
analyze.textPlaceholder: After PDF upload, text appears here... or paste it manually.
analyze.goalPlaceholder: e.g. clear and fair, without escalation
analyze.conversationTypeNote: The evaluation is tuned for employee conversations. More conversation types will follow.
analyze.rolesHint: Choose the manager (employee will be set automatically)
analyze.speakerTip: Tip: After upload/paste, speakers are detected automatically.
analyze.manualRolesOn: Speakers not detected? Enter roles manually

analyze.anonymizeHint: Happens in the browser, before anything is sent to the API.
analyze.costNote: The analysis costs 1 credit ({eur}). If it fails for technical reasons, the credit is refunded.
analyze.saveTranscriptHint: Stores the analyzed (anonymized) text so you can review it later in the report.
analyze.saveFailed: Analysis succeeded, but saving failed. Your result is kept — retry saving.
analyze.anonymizeOffWarning: Without anonymization, real names from the transcript are sent to the AI model.
analyze.aiNotice: The evaluation is performed by an AI. Your transcript is sent to an AI model for this.

dashboard.title: Session history
dashboard.searchPlaceholder: Search by goal, ID or date…
dashboard.noAnalysesHint: It looks like you haven't analyzed any conversations for this session yet. Start your first analysis now!
dashboard.bindingTooltipRun: Analyses are tied to the browser session — “New session” starts a fresh list.

report.followUpHint: Downloads a calendar entry for you – you decide when to measure again.

entry.title: Practice
entry.h1: What do you want to practice today, {name}?
entry.h1NoName: What do you want to practice today?
entry.sub: Practice live with an AI persona — or bring a real conversation. Both paths lead to the same evaluation.
entry.dropTitle: Already had a real conversation? Drop the transcript here
entry.dropMeta: Teams PDF or text · anonymisation built in
entry.recoReason: Recommended: your last result shows the biggest gap in {c}.
entry.coldStartFrame: Start with an entry-level scenario — the evaluation will then show you what to work on.
entry.ghostBody: Briefly describe the situation you want to practice — your request feeds straight into the prioritisation of new scenarios.
entry.wishPlaceholder: e.g. a salary conversation with a top performer who might quit
entry.wishThanks: Thanks! Your request has been received and feeds into the prioritisation of new scenarios.
entry.dropWrongType: Only PDF is accepted here — use the analysis page for text.
entry.transferTitle: Your intention from the last conversation
entry.transferQuestion: How did it go in real life?
entry.transferThanks: Thanks — this feeds into your next debrief.
entry.prepBody: Describe in three sentences what is coming up and how the other person behaves. You get a private practice conversation that only you can see.
entry.prepAnlassPh: e.g. Tomorrow I meet my project lead about the delayed delivery. He has not explained the delay so far.
entry.prepGegen: How does the other person behave?
entry.prepGegenPh: e.g. Evades, points to other departments, gets curt when criticised and ends conversations quickly.
entry.prepZiel: What do you want to achieve? (optional)
entry.prepZielPh: e.g. A fixed date and clear responsibilities by Friday.
entry.prepHint: Describe behaviour, not people: no real names, no company names. The coach replaces names with roles and invents a character.
entry.prepCost: Costs 1 credit. The conversation stays private with you for 30 days. Nobody else sees it, not even an admin.
entry.prepLimit: You can keep at most three prepared conversations at a time. Remove one, then you can build a new one.

evaluation.calcScale: Each rating from 1 to 4 becomes 0, 33, 67 or 100 %.
evaluation.calcOnlyCheckpoints: Result: only the key moments count = {overall} %.
evaluation.calcUnrated: Fewer than half of the competencies were observable, so there is no verdict.
evaluation.commitHint: It only becomes a commitment when you click. After three days the coach asks how it went.
evaluation.commitPlaceholder: What will you do differently next time?
evaluation.courseWishTitle: No course for this? Ask for one.
evaluation.courseWishBody: Your admins see the wish in the learning area. Colleagues can join it.
evaluation.courseWishText: I want to get better at {c}. This showed in the AI coach.
evaluation.commitmentQuestion: What will you concretely do differently next time?
evaluation.studioBridgeBody: Create a course in the Learning Studio — tailored to {c}.

diagnose.itemBrowser: Browser, screen size, language, online status

diagnose.shortcutHint: Shortcut: Ctrl + Alt + D. Send the file to support together with the error number.

interview.title: Short interview
interview.missingCourse: The course this interview belongs to is missing. Please open it from the course ending.
interview.notEnabled: The short interview is not yet enabled for your company (pilot).
interview.adminOnly: Only admins can see the report.
interview.errorGeneric: That did not work. Please try again.
interview.introBody: An AI interviewer asks you five short questions about the course and follows up at most once. There are no wrong answers; the more concrete, the more useful for the course author.
interview.introPrivacy: Your answers are combined with others into a theme report that admins only see from five people on. Names and individual answers do not appear there.
interview.introCost: Finishing the interview costs 1 credit (up to {eur}).
interview.placeholder: Your answer … (Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a new line)
interview.finishHint: That was the last question. Finishing costs 1 credit (up to {eur}).
interview.thanksBody: They flow anonymously into the theme report for the course once five people have answered.
interview.berichtIntro: Theme report from {k} finished interviews per course. No names, no individual answers.
interview.berichtNone: No interviews yet. Learners find the short interview at the end of a hosted course.
